gen-tourney-gf-aclonica: Stretched, sporty and sturdy. Tourney cuts every stroke to one width, while Aclonica, a plain sans, lets its strokes thicken and thin so gently you feel it more than see it.
gen-tourney-gf-allerta: Allerta reads wide and loosely tracked, with a prominent x-height that makes each line feel generous. Tourney's bulky, uniform strokes sit above it, so Allerta's plain sans text gets room to breathe underneath the heavy heading.
gen-tourney-gf-alumni-sans: Alumni Sans reads lean and friendly, its ascenders barely clearing the x-height and its c pulled wide open. And if Tourney were made small, its wide tracking and bulky lowercase would crowd, since the body has the subtle swell it lacks.
gen-tourney-gf-alumni-sans-pinstripe: Loud meets lean here. Tourney's wide-set, single-width strokes look sporty and heavy, and Alumni Sans Pinstripe tucks in underneath with a tight word texture and lowercase that towers over its small capitals.
gen-tourney-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Alumni Sans SC reads compact, its lowercase looking oversized beside its capitals and its stems outweighing hairlines only slightly. Longer text would feel dense and contemporary, with Tourney's even strokes offering a blunt contrast.
gen-tourney-gf-anaheim: Anaheim packs its lowercase into a dense huddle, rounded forms staying open to the side, a sans-serif with a modern, friendly feel. But Tourney carries the weight, since its strokes have no calligraphic thinning and its wide tracking gives the pair a sporty edge.
gen-tourney-gf-arsenal: Arsenal reads close-knit, its x-height nearly touching the capitals. Tourney is best when big and blunt, cut like a router bit, while Arsenal's sans strokes handle the quieter job of running text with a gentle weight shift.
gen-tourney-gf-arsenal-sc: Arsenal SC reads tight and tidy, with a faint thick-thin shift and wide mouths. Tourney earns its keep big and short, where its constant stroke width and stretched tracking can really show off.
gen-tourney-gf-asimovian: Asimovian is a sans with tall lowercase bodies and strokes built from one width, so it reads friendly and uniform. And Tourney, with its stretched tracking and bulky small letters, would give a longer text block a brawny, athletic lead-in.
gen-tourney-gf-basic: Basic keeps things tidy, with only a gentle bump from small letters to capitals. Basic's low-key sans shapes let Tourney, where it earns its keep big and short, own the rope-like, athletic spotlight.
